reviewMethod: Decoded all 12 GIFs / 96 frames, verified dimensions, frame timings, repeat flag and correspondence to RGBA atlas pixels within palette error.
Inspected every atlas frame at native 320x320 size on white, black and green: 24 native-alpha plates / 288 composites.
Regenerated and inspected four comparison cards from actual source crops with renderer insets, at 1:1 size; no sprite artwork was changed.
Confirmed exact horizontal mirroring of all four cook down-left rows and TH carry side-left using RGBA pixel comparison.
Read WORKER_ROW_V2, face flip, frame insets and fit tables in src/workers.js.
playbackBlocker: Fresh CUA inventory returned browsers=[] and Browsers: Error: The browser access host is unavailable. No playback was observed.

acceptance.alphaVerificationScope: All 32 TH carry frames and 64 cook frames inspected in native-size composites on white/black/green; no unexpected colour fringe observed. Not an in-game QA result.

knownIssues: cook TH: head wider/larger relative to original; shorter torso/legs; identity and proportion jump around frame 4 to 5.
cook asia: face/eyes and outline texture differ from source; spoon position resets between frames 8 and 1.
cook west: head smaller and body/legs longer than source, feet and body posture change around frames 7-8.
cook cyberhell: head smaller and legs longer than source; face/body shift through the row.
All four cook down-left rows are exact mirrors, moving the one-sided pouch/rope/emblem to the opposite side.
TH carry retains all four rows / 32 frames, but face and proportions still differ from the original worker.
foot [160,320] and 320px layout are preserved; anatomical registration against source including renderer fit is not certified.
Loop smoothness is not certified: only decoded frames and seams were inspected, not continuous playback.

foot.note: Lower-band silhouette centre is diagnostic only: walking changes the planted foot and lifting the other foot changes the silhouette. It is not the draw anchor. Exact foot contact against the source is not certified.
